name: New Project Path Validation
user_story: As a user, I want a new project to fail clearly instead of disappearing when its folder path is invalid

notes: Round 57 fixed manual nonexistent-path acceptance; 4/4 Foundation tests; native folder picker and macOS UI unverified.

name: Workspace Switch Reloads Sessions
user_story: As a user, I want switching projects to show only that project's sessions

notes: Round 57 fixed selected-workspace shadowing; 2/2 Foundation tests; macOS SQLite execution unverified.

notes: Round 57 fixed project DB undercount; 2/2 Foundation aggregation tests; live SQLite/UI runtime unverified.

user_story: As a user, I want the top shell to show the workspace, branch, session and goal belonging to the active project
